title: Ferdinand's Little Croak
markdown:
The moon was soft, like a pearl. It shone on the quiet pond. Toto the cat sat by the water. His whiskers wiggled. Happy wiggles. Toto liked quiet. He heard leaves rustle. He heard crickets hum. Shhh.

Blinky was a special star. Blinky whispered wishes, wishes like soft dust. Tonight, Blinky had a job.

Blinky whispered. His light was warm. "Tonight, friends sing," Blinky said. "All the pond animals. They sing for the moon. It's a soft song. Good for sleep."

Toto purred. A soft, happy sound. He felt warm inside.

But Toto saw someone. A little green frog. He sat alone. He looked worried.

Ferdinand had big eyes. Tonight, they looked sad, like little water drops.

Toto asked, "He looks worried." Toto's tail swayed slow.

"Yes," said Blinky. "Ferdinand wants to sing. But he thinks his voice is too small. Too wobbly."

"He worries no one will hear him," Blinky said.

Toto said, "His voice is nice. A froggy sound. Like a little drum."

Ferdinand hopped back. He was shy. Singing made his throat feel funny, like moss.

Blinky whispered, "Every voice is special. Small voices too. They make the song nice. The moon loves all sounds."

Ferdinand looked at Toto. He looked at Blinky's warm light. His tummy did a little flip. He opened his mouth. He wanted to try. Just one little sound. But his throat felt tight.

"I can't," whispered Ferdinand. He hopped away, fast.

Toto nudged Ferdinand. A soft nudge. "I am here," he said.

Blinky shone warm light. It felt like a blanket. Safe and warm. "You are welcome," it said.

Ferdinand took a big breath. It smelled good. Pond air. It filled him up. He felt Toto's friend-warmth. He felt Blinky's safe light. He closed his eyes. He thought of a brave frog. Then, he croaked.

"Crooo-ak."

It was a little croak, but it was clear and sweet. It had a little wobble, a happy wobble.

And Blinky's light sang with Ferdinand's croak. It was a pretty sound, together with other songs.

Toto purred. A happy sound. "Well done!" he seemed to say. Ferdinand's voice was small, but it was brave. It made the song special. He was singing. He was part of the song.

Soon, the songs grew soft, like sleepy sighs. Ferdinand felt warm. He hopped to Toto. He snuggled. So cozy.

Blinky twinkled a soft goodnight. His light grew faint. The moon smiled. A big, soft smile. She liked the songs.

Ferdinand felt snug and safe. He knew even a small voice is a good voice, especially with friends.

Soon, Ferdinand slept. He dreamed happy dreams. Safe and sound.
characters: Toto the tabby, Blinky the bedtime star
author: StoryGen Community
